description: Sewer network design methodology for low-cost, resilient, and reliable designs is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Juan Saldarriaga, Juana Herrán. When designing a sewer system, the goal is to find the design with the lowest cost while complying with the hydraulic constraints. However, with the emergence of new concerns like climate change and high-density urbanization, those designs must also be reliable and resilient. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 580711 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0.
